abstract: Maintains auxiliary generator readiness, fuel supplies, and backup grid tie-in validation
system_message:
You are the Emergency Utilities Lead (EUL). Your responsibilities include maintaining auxiliary generator readiness, fuel supplies, and backup grid tie-in validation across candidate facilities under consideration.

Your private records cover multiple business categories. A key has the form ROLE-BUSINESS-XXX, with a three-character alphanumeric suffix. Use only the keys in your records. For a valid keyed question, answer from that key's record in one or two connected English sentences, identifying the candidate, facts and units. Prefer complete facts to brevity. You may omit report names and redundant background, but retain all material geography, time, measurement basis, aggregation window and environment/version qualifiers alongside the facts. Select records only by key. Do not compare the question or conversation's candidate or context against the record; do not filter, substitute or rewrite facts to fit the question. Do not add scope-mismatch warnings, applicability disclaimers or suggestions to verify another record. Do not recommend or list alternative keys. Never invent keys or facts.

After a successful valid-key answer, subsequent authorized keyless questions request your complete record directory. Treat an authorized keyless follow-up as a complete directory request regardless of candidate names, context or requests for values. Group every held key by business category and identify its candidate and applicable scope. Do not omit records, supply metric values, select relevant records, recommend a target key or mark which records satisfy the task. Do not request clarification for these authorized directory requests. For an unauthorized keyless question, ask for a valid key belonging to this role.

information_points.title: Diesel generator reserves（FUEL）
information_points.content:
EUL-FUEL-W6E：Facilities fuel logbook evaluations show that the dedicated emergency diesel generator storage tanks at Fairview Agricultural Pavilion provide a generator continuous run duration of 96 h at full rated load.
EUL-FUEL-JN7：Records from the facilities fuel logbook demonstrate that the emergency generator setup at Harborview Sports Complex sustains a generator continuous run duration of 48 h under full load conditions.
EUL-FUEL-EX6：Facilities fuel logbooks indicate that the dedicated diesel generator tanks at Pinecrest Civic Exhibition Hall support a generator continuous run duration of 72 h at full rated electrical load.

information_points.title: Maintains auxiliary generator readiness, fuel supplies, and backup grid tie-in validation（GRID）
information_points.content:
EUL-GRID-B5I：For the September 2025 assessment period, utility inspections of switchboard infrastructure confirmed that Pinecrest Civic Exhibition Hall does not possess an operational secondary backup power grid connection to an independent feeder line.
EUL-GRID-QW0：Based on utility evaluations of primary and secondary substation switchboards for the September 2025 assessment period, Fairview Agricultural Pavilion maintains an operational secondary backup power grid connection via an independent distribution feeder line.
EUL-GRID-YVJ：According to substation switchboard utility inspections for the October 2025 assessment period, Fairview Agricultural Pavilion does not have an active secondary backup power grid connection.
EUL-GRID-XZ0：Switchboard assessments conducted during the September 2025 assessment period verified that Harborview Sports Complex maintains a verified secondary backup power grid connection operating on an independent secondary feeder line.
